Are you looking for a bird feeder with a built-in camera that automatically records birds visiting your feeder?

These are often called smart bird feeders or AI bird feeder cameras. They can capture photos and videos, send notifications to your phone, and sometimes identify bird species.

There are two main options: an all-in-one bird feeder with a camera, or a bird feeder designed to hold an existing camera.
